note: p6-slim-verify (docs/66 §7.1, 2026-10-25): correctness + memory check of the P5/P6 clone slimming switches on game-copy/ts3native.asi.slim (= native/ts3native/out-slim, ts3native 0.36.73, counters v133; release ini unchanged: both switches default off). A1 [RouteSnap] PoolChunkMB=16 (pool regions of 16 MB reserved as they fill, up to 96) + A3 EpochHeap=1 (one clone build per load: the cut waits from world event 9 / 0x0A to event 7; one heap per clone build, destroyed with its last block), P6 on (TakeKinds=9, P6EarlyCopy, TakeKindsAll), VerifyEvery=1 (every armed job runs the clone and then the game's plan, §13 compare), [MemDiag] + [UserDiag] for the memory lines, A4 readout [RouteSnap] LotUseReadout=1 (per clone lot: bytes by structure and route jobs / agents that read it; untouched share at each memory sample and at a clean exit). Read: node tools/harness/lot-use-report.ts --filter p6-slim (top 20 lots by bytes, untouched share, verdict simple variant vs full A4 per docs/66 §7.1). Correctness runs, not timing (VerifyEvery=1 doubles route cost). PASS per job = nativeRequire + logForbid + logRequire, plus by hand: one 'snap replay: clone built' line before the 'diag: memory at world load' line (asked by the event-7 site), and the memory gate from the 'diag: memory at world load' / 'at 10 min' lines against the docs/66 §7 routesnap medians (largest free at load BP 1,413 / IP 1,415 MB, after 10-16 min BP 1,097 / IP 1,333 MB): predicted gain >= +50 MB at load and >= +60 MB at 10 min [inferred, ledger §350: A1 ~48-64 MB of the 96 MB reserve, A3 ~20 MB of the double-build peak]; direct counters plSavedKB (pool reserve left free), rpGenRelKB (heap blocks handed back), rpLoadWaitCuts. Fail = any m2VerBad / p6BorrowVerBad, a crash, plFull > 0, a load-wait timeout, two clone builds at load, or the gain under the prediction (then read rpGenLive: heaps pinned by long-lived blocks).

jobs.note: BP, P6 on, PoolChunkMB=16 + EpochHeap=1, VerifyEvery=1, repro route-queuefull-replan-loop (30+ own Go Here STARTs per firing; its arms flip fallbackasync, P6 stays on), 12 min so the 10-min memory line lands.
